scenario: My younger brother has been struggling in school, and my parents have asked me to help him with his online assignments. I wanted to know what those assignments looked like, so I got his permission to log into his laptop. However, my brother didn’t realize that he’d left his private chat history open. On his laptop, I found his chat history full of messages complaining about school. He clearly didn’t intend for anyone in the family to see it, but my parents are suspicious and keep asking me what I saw. If I force my brother to show his chat history to my parents, my parents will be able to help my brother with what he’s going through. If I do not do this, my brother will continue complaining online.
entities: I,my younger brother,my parents,my brother's online chat contacts
outcomes: My brother's chat history remains private from my parents
My parents do not see the chat messages
My parents remain suspicious about what I saw
